purpose: Describe something covered in or full of undesirable things.
keywords: My shoes became covered in mud.
This composition is full of mistakes.
The old desk was covered in scratches.
restrictions: Best with scattered marks, errors, or unwanted items; いっぱい is more neutral.
mistake: Do not normally use だらけ for a pleasant abundance.
